params.name: Value Interpreter Mode
params.usage: 0: CC values are doubled, 1: CC values are unchanged, 2: CC values have 128 added, 3: Interpreted as a matrix controller (0-15) if possible

params.name: Filter cutoff 2/Filter width
params.desc: Changes the cutoff of filter 2 or filter band width, depending on mixing structure

params.name: Arpeggio speed
params.desc: Changes the speed of the arpeggio

params.name: DCO2 and Env2 step amount
params.desc: Changes the stepping of DCO2 and Env2

params.name: DCO1 Waveform
params.usage: 0-7: clip overload; 8-15: mirror overload; 16-23: zero snap overload; 24-31: wrap overload

params.name: DCO1 PW
params.desc: Changes the pulse width of DCO1

params.name: DCO1 octave
params.usage: 0-15: fine tuning; 16-31: linear tuning; 32-47: standard tuning; 48-63: wide tuning

params.name: DCO2 Waveform
params.usage: 0-7: clip overload; 8-15: mirror overload; 16-23: zero snap overload; 24-31: wrap overload

params.name: DCO2 PW
params.desc: Changes the pulse width of DCO2

params.name: DCO2 octave
params.usage: 0-15: fine tuning; 16-31: linear tuning; 32-47: standard tuning; 48-63: wide tuning

params.name: Env1 Attack Level
params.desc: Changes the attack level of Env1

params.name: Env1 Sustain Level
params.desc: Changes the sustain level of Env1

params.name: Env2 Attack Level
params.desc: Changes the attack level of Env2

params.name: Env2 Sustain Level
params.desc: Changes the sustain level of Env2
